sections.heading: ARTIST DIPLOMA IN PERFORMANCE (ONE-YEAR PROGRAM) - admission suspended
lines: Don Wright Faculty of Music - Diplomas in the Don Wright Faculty of Music

Admission to this program is suspended effective September 1, 2023 and until further notice. Students enrolled in the program for the 2023-24 academic year will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the program requirements by August 31, 2024.

For admission to this program, applicants must hold a Bachelor of Music degree or its equivalent. They must also demonstrate a performance level of at least a Conservatory Associate standard and show evidence of exceptional performance ability.

sections.heading: Program
lines: Music 4923, Music 4932A/B/Y and 0.5 course from the Department of Music Performance Studies.
1.0 course or equivalent from the Faculty of Music.
1.0 course or equivalent from any Faculty.
Note: Voice majors must include Music 2942A/B/Y and Music 3942A/B/Y as electives.

sections.heading: Eligibility for Graduation
lines: A weighted average of at least 70% and no mark less than 60% in Music courses, and a passing grade in non-Music courses.
